title: Review repair E: read-only sandbox closes the bare-relative-path push, and every claim about it says what it is
description:
From the final re-review (findings at /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-peterengelbrecht-Development-ticfac/1687f85b-9680-4c8b-ad98-ebe61eb3bfb3/scratchpad/review/reverify-findings.md, probe script at /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-peterengelbrecht-Development-ticfac/1687f85b-9680-4c8b-ad98-ebe61eb3bfb3/scratchpad/review/bypass/probe.sh, read-only on this host). You own internal/exec/subprocess and the doc/prompt lines named here; sibling repair F owns internal/reconcile.

(1) internal/exec/subprocess/grade.go:66 pushURLPrefixes covers absolute paths, ./, ../, ~ and every scheme but not a BARE relative path: 'git push link HEAD:refs/heads/x' with link a relative symlink or path to the origin (or any local clone with credentials) is not rewritten and lands on the remote under the read-only grade (probe case 4). Close it: pin a pushInsteadOf for the no-prefix case too (git matches url.<prefix>.pushInsteadOf on the literal url, so consider a catch-all via 'url.ticfac-read-only-grade::.pushInsteadOf' for each of the empty-prefix forms, or refuse pushes at the remote-helper level by setting remote.pushDefault plus 'protocol.allow=never' for file/ssh/http… whichever combination the probe proves) and add the probe's cases 3, 4 and 5 as tests in grade_test.go (longer url.<prefix>.pushInsteadOf wins over the pin; -c remote.evil.url plus its own pushInsteadOf; bare relative path). (2) Say what the boundary is, once, and identically: grade.go:39-46 documents the -c residual but not bare paths; doc.go:85-91 ends 'the refusal is the issuer's and not the model's manners' which is only true for a well-mannered runner; profiles/review-epic.md:4-7 says 'git push fails whatever you point it at'; contracts/job-protocol.json:268 says 'refused by the issuer, not by the runner's good manners'. State precisely: an accidental push fails at launch configuration; a deliberate runner that brings its own credential (ssh identity in ~/.ssh, -c credential.helper) is not stopped by this executor, and the boundary diff at collect is the backstop. Do NOT edit the vendored contract bundle JSON's normative fields (contracts/ is pinned to ticks@5d14bcb); if the prose there is wrong, note it in RESULT-E.md as an upstream ticks finding for the orchestrator to file, and keep the Go doc honest. (3) profiles_test.go:192 TestTheReviewRunsReadOnlyAtTheControllerState asserts only the JobSpec field; make it exercise the launched sandbox (or delete the duplicate assertion and point at the grade_test that does). Run the subprocess package tests plus go test -short -timeout 45m ./... before reporting.
